record.official_rationale: Protest opposition to pandemic-response policies; authorities also cited immediate safety and secure-area concerns.
record.uncertainty: Two crossings and several mechanisms must remain separate. Sarnia endpoint/continuity conflict: ten-hour February 6 disruption versus February 8 service-resumption account. Later February 9–14 highway blockage had an operational detour and is not a closed-port spell. Peace February 12 facility lockdown is not automatically all-traffic closure; a February 13 commercial suspension and February 14 11:00 resumption are explicit. Summary places outbound blockage earlier, on February 12.

Primary operational synthesis resolves occurrence and movement scope at both crossings, while a second official summary exposes timing differences. Preserve those differences as bounds and withhold numeric durations. Do not add the detoured inland highway blockade as a port closure.
